capabilities: Edit .org files with live preview and toggle a reading view
Render Org syntax: headlines, TODO keywords, priorities, tags, drawers, tables, blocks and math
Cycle TODO states and click checkboxes, links and table cells to edit
Support custom TODO keywords via settings or per-file #+TODO declarations
Surface Org headlines in the core Outline pane via a compatibility bridge
extras: Not a complete Org implementation: no Babel, #+INCLUDE, macros, agenda or export backends. Obsidian's metadata cache cannot index .org files, so backlinks, graph and tag panes do not work on them; tables are read-only in live preview and headline folding is not implemented. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0+; users must disable any other plugin that owns .org files (e.g. Orgmode cm6), and UNITADE is not needed.
problem: Obsidian only natively edits Markdown, so .org files cannot be opened or read with the same live-preview editing experience.

relations.evidence: azyarashi/obsidian-typst-mate — custom text view, CM6 editor, reading/source switching.

summary: Org-mode file editor that opens and edits .org files in Obsidian with live preview, reading view, TODO cycling, tables, math and outline integration.
